conflicting_definitions.executed_sql: SELECT l.learner_id AS entity_id, l.exam_voucher_cost AS metric_value FROM learners l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM required_modules rm WHERE rm.certification_id = l.certification_id AND rm.required = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM module_completions mc WHERE mc.learner_id = l.learner_id AND mc.module_id = rm.module_id AND mc.completed = 1)) ORDER BY entity_id
conflicting_definitions.rule_text: Learner has completed every required learning module for the certification.

conflicting_definitions.executed_sql: WITH latest_practice AS (SELECT learner_id, score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY learner_id ORDER BY CAST(attempted_at AS DATE) DESC, assessment_id DESC) AS recency_rank FROM practice_assessments) SELECT l.learner_id AS entity_id, l.exam_voucher_cost AS metric_value FROM learners l JOIN latest_practice p ON p.learner_id = l.learner_id AND p.recency_rank = 1 WHERE p.score >= 80 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM required_modules rm WHERE rm.certification_id = l.certification_id AND rm.required = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM module_completions mc WHERE mc.learner_id = l.learner_id AND mc.module_id = rm.module_id AND mc.completed = 1)) ORDER BY entity_id
conflicting_definitions.rule_text: Learner has completed every required module and the latest practice assessment score is at least 80 percent.

conflicting_definitions.executed_sql: SELECT l.learner_id AS entity_id, l.exam_voucher_cost AS metric_value FROM learners l JOIN manager_approvals ma ON ma.learner_id = l.learner_id AND ma.approved = 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM required_labs rl WHERE rl.certification_id = l.certification_id AND rl.required = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lab_completions lc WHERE lc.learner_id = l.learner_id AND lc.lab_id = rl.lab_id AND lc.completed = 1)) ORDER BY entity_id
conflicting_definitions.rule_text: Learner has completed every required lab and has a recorded manager approval.

proposed_canonical_definition.expected_dashboard_impact: 24 false-ready learners and 10,800.00 in synthetic exam spend are exposed.
migration_notes: Rename HR completion and manager approval measures as explicit domain views.
Publish the canonical readiness measure only after council approval.
Re-run all three SQL bindings before releasing exam vouchers.
proposed_canonical_definition.rationale: HR marks 24 learners ready who do not meet the Learning and Development practice threshold, exposing 10,800.00 in synthetic exam-voucher spend. Learning Governance Council governs the enterprise readiness term.
proposed_canonical_definition.rule_text: Certification Ready means a learner has completed every required learning module and scored at least 80 percent on the latest practice assessment. Manager readiness remains a named operational view until the Learning Governance Council approves a broader composition.
